{{Quote|I'll finish things up here, then check in with Hapjax and clear him to clean up the rest of it. An hour, maybe less, and it'll be done.|Vestin Axlon, to the [[Gangster/Legends|thug]] [[Dors Stelikag]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Hapjax''' was an individual.<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Major]], the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Vestin Axlon]], who served the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>
[[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], [[Battle for Poln Major|captured]] the [[Hand of Judgment]], a group formed by five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Once he was done with the stormtroopers, Axlon was to report to Hapjax and allow him to clean up what the Alderaanian referred to as the "rest of it," which would take around an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]]. However, Axlon was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Joak Quiller]], a member of the Hand of Judgment, before he could contact Hapjax.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hapjax was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
